title: Effect of carrier gas type on the microstructure and mechanical properties of alumina dispersion-strengthened copper for cold spray additive manufacturing

preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: Ground using 400 grit sandpaper, cleaned with alcohol

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: Given the severe deformation of particles during cold spraying when using He as the carrier gas, the ADS Cu deposit exhibits a denser microstructure and a relatively lower porosity compared with that produced with N2. Refined grain structure with He as process gas in comparison to N2.
